newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo to invest 47 bln yen in LCD plant.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo to invest 47 bln yen in LCD plant.

text.p: Sanyo Electric Co said on Wednesday that it plans to spend 47 billion yen to construct a plant to make thin-film-transistor liquid-crystal displays in Japan's Tottori prefecture.
It said the plant would begin operating at the beginning of 1998.
Sanyo said in a statement that the new plant, to be run by its subsidiary Tottori Sanyo Electric Co, would produce 12.1-inch LCD panels using 550 mm by 650 mm glass substrates.
It forecast that annual sales of TFT-LCD products from the new factory would be about 50 billion yen by 2000.
Sanyo currently produces only small-size TFT panels and less-advanced but cheaper STN (super-twisted nematic) type LCD panels at the parent company and the subsidiary.
It said the new factory would employ about 500 people.
